name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.
Raise your arms on either side with a slight bend in your elbow until they are parallel with the floor. Pause at the top of the motion.
Slowly return your arms down to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lay flat on the incline bench with your feet on the ground. Raise the dumbbells until you have straight arms.
Lower the dumbbells to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Incline Chest Flys
instructions: Lay flat on the bench and place your feet on the ground.
Begin the exercise with the dumbbells held together above your chest, elbows slightly bent.
Simultaneously lower the weights to either side.
Pause when the weights are parallel to the bench, then raise your arms to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
instructions: Grab two dumbbells while standing upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support. Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height with your palms forward.
Raise the dumbbells upwards and pause at the contracted position.
Lower the weights back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Bayesian Lateral Raise
instructions: Lay on an incline bench and let your arms freely.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Dumbbell Decline Neutral Bench Press
instructions: Lie on the decline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Incline Bench Press
instructions: Lie on an incline bench, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Seated Overhead Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to your shoulder joint, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Once the dumbbells reach your chest, pause for a moment and then press them back up to the starting position.
This variation is much easier on the shoulder joints.

name: Dumbbell Seated Arnold Press
instructions: Begin seated on an upright bench with your palms facing you.
Begin pressing toward the ceiling. As you press, rotate your palms.
As you extend your elbows fully your palms should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Arnold Press
instructions: Start in a standing position

name: Dumbbell Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start with two dumbbells just above your shoulders.
Press one dumbbell to the ceiling while keeping the other in place.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other dumbbell.

name: Dumbbell Arnold Press
instructions: Stand with both palms facing you.
Begin to press the dumbbells to the ceiling while rotating your palms.
When you reach elbow extension, your palms should be facing forward.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Alternating Overhead Press
instructions: Start with two dumbbells near your shoulders with a neutral grip.
Press one of the dumbbells toward the ceiling while keeping the other in position.
Let the first dumbbell return to its starting position before pressing the other.

name: Dumbbell Neutral Overhead Press
instructions: Start with both dumbbells near your shoulders in a neutral grip.
Press the dumbbells toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't arch your back as you fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing forward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, extend your arms upwards so that the dumbbells are overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Arnold Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Neutral Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing your body and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, press the dumbbell upwards so that it is directly above your shoulder.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing forward and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is overhead.
Make sure to keep your core engaged and your back straight throughout the movement.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
instructions: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bring the dumbbells to your shoulders, with your palms facing inward and your elbows bent.
From this starting position, dip your knees slightly and then quickly extend them as you press the dumbbells upwards.
As you press the dumbbells upwards, also push your hips forward to help generate additional power.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

name: Laying Lateral Raise
instructions: Lay on your side on a bench or box. Place one hand on the floor and the other hand is holding the dumbbell.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Squat
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and hold two dumbbells overhead with both hands, using an overhand grip.
Begin the squat by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your core tight and the dumbbells balanced overhead.
Lower your body as far as you can while keeping the dumbbells overhead, then push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, making sure to keep your back straight, chest lifted, and the dumbbells stable overhead throughout the entire movement.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted, engage your core to maintain balance.
Begin the movement by lifting the dumbbell straight up towards your chin, keeping your elbow close to your body and the weight in line with your shoulder.
Continue to lift the weight until it reaches the chin or neck level, keeping the elbow high and close to the body.
Lower the weight back down to the starting position with control.

name: Dumbbell Upright Row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding 2 dumbbells in each hand.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted, engage your core to maintain balance.
Begin the movement by lifting the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, keeping your elbow close to your body and the weight in line with your shoulder.
Continue to lift the weight until it reaches the chin or neck level, keeping the elbow high and close to the body.

name: Seated Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit upright on bench or box.
Hold dumbbells at sides
Lift arms to shoulder height.

name: Dumbbell Bent Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a 90 degree bend at your elbows.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Dumbbell High Incline Bench Press
instructions: Position the bench between 45 and 60 degrees.
Lay flat on the bench with your feet on the ground.
Lower the bar to your mid chest
Raise the dumbbells (slowly and controlled) until you've locked your elbows.

name: Dumbbell Standing Bayesian Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall on lean slightly forward.
Lateral raise your arms straight out to the side until your arms are about parallel with the ground.

name: Dumbbell Cuban Press
instructions: Perform an upright row until elbows are bent at 90 degrees and arms parallel to the ground.
Rotate your shoulders, raising the dumbbells overhead. Then press overhead.

name: Dumbbell Full Front Raise
instructions: Stand tall with an overhand grip on the dumbbell. Raise your arms until your fists are pointed toward the ceiling.
Return to the start under control. This exercise is prone to using momentum when you begin to fatigue.

name: Dumbbell Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand up straight with dumbbells at either side, palms facing your hips.
Raise your arms on either side with a slight bend in your elbow until they are over head. Pause at the top of the motion.
Slowly return your arms down to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Overhead Press
instructions: Take a half kneeling position while holding two dumbbells.
Drive the dumbbells upwards.

name: Dumbbell Half Kneeling Single Arm Overhead Press
instructions: Take a half kneeling position while holding one dumbbell.
Drive the dumbbell upwards.

name: Dumbbell Incline Front Raise
instructions: Grab two dumbbells while sitting on an incline bench upright with the dumbbells at your side.
Raise the two dumbbells with your elbows being fully extended until the dumbbells are eye level.
Lower the weights in a controlled manner to the starting position and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Internal Rotation
instructions: Lay flat on the ground with your elbow on the floor and dumbbell pointed toward the ceiling.
Lower the dumbbell until your knuckles get close to the ground. Then back to the starting position.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Arnold Press
instructions: Start by sitting on an incline bench and holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Bring the dumbbell to your shoulder, with your palm facing you and your elbow bent.
From this starting position, extend your arm upwards so that the dumbbell is directly above your head.
As you extend your arm, rotate your palm to face away from your body.

name: Dumbbell Seated Y Press
instructions: Sit on an upright bench , grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Dumbbell Six Way Lateral Raise
instructions: Perform a front raise, then bring dumbbells out to your side, then raise the dumbbells over head.

name: Dumbbell Y Press
instructions: Stand tall, grasp a pair of dumbbells and hold them at shoulder level with your palms facing each other. Keep your elbows bent and close to your body.
Press the dumbbells outward into a y shape.

name: Dumbbell Laying Incline Lateral Raise
instructions: Lay on your side on an incline bench. Brace yourself by holding onto the bench.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, raise the dumbbell to the side.
The end of the range of motion is when the dumbbell is pointed toward the ceiling.
Make sure you don't flex and extend your elbow.

name: Dumbbell Alternating Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing inward.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing one dumbbell overhead.
Lower dumbbell as you descend again, alternating arms each rep.

name: Dumbbell Clean And Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at sides, hinge slightly, and explosively pull to shoulders.
Catch dumbbells at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press overhead until arms extend, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Hang Clean And Press
instructions: Hold dumbbells at thighs with slight knee bend and flat back.
Pull dumbbells to shoulders explosively, catching them in partial squat.
Stand tall and press overhead until arms are fully extended.

name: Dumbbell Neutral High Incline Bench Press
instructions: Set bench to high incline and hold dumbbells with neutral grip at shoulders.
Press dumbbells upward until arms extend without locking elbows.
Lower slowly to shoulder level and repeat.

name: Dumbbell Seated Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall holding dumbbells at sides with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arms outward until arms go overhead.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall holding one dumbbell at your side with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arm outward until arms go overhead.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.

name: Dumbbell Seated Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Sit tall with one dumbbell at your side, palm facing inward.
Lift arm outward until shoulder height, keeping elbow slightly bent.
Lower smoothly and repeat, keeping torso still.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Clean And Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell between legs, hinge slightly, and pull explosively to shoulder.
Catch dumbbell at shoulder height with knees slightly bent.
Press overhead until arm fully extends, then lower under control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Hang Clean And Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell in one hand at thigh level with slight knee bend.
Pull dumbbell upward explosively to shoulder, catching it smoothly.
Press overhead, fully extending arm, then return to start position.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Push Press
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip slightly at knees, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead.
Lock out arm briefly, then lower dumbbell under control.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbell at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, then drive upward, pressing dumbbell overhead in one motion.
Lower dumbbell as you descend into next rep smoothly.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Full Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall with a single dumbbell at your side.
Raise the dumbbell with your elbow mostly extended until it is above your head.

name: Dumbbell Single Arm Lateral Raise
instructions: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with slight bend in elbows.
Raise arm outward until arms are parallel with the ground.
Lower under control, maintaining constant tension on delts.
